Stage Description: Client onboarding patient registration and emergency room triaging.
Process Description: Sorting patients based on severity of their condition to direct them to appropriate trauma wards.
Business Problem: Manual sorting by nurse practitioners is slow under peak hours leading to patient transfer delays.
Research Document Title: Optimizing ER Triaging Workflows via Clinical Intelligence
Research Document Text: Research by the National Health Authority demonstrates that automated triaging indexes save up to 40% wait times in emergency care. By applying text parsing to symptoms notes hospital desks allocate critical trauma resources to severe cases within seconds.

Stage Description: Medical imaging laboratory testing and pathology reporting.
Process Description: Reading raw X-ray and CT scan files to identify structural abnormalities or fractures.
Business Problem: Radiologists spend hours scanning hundreds of slides causing delays in ICU surgery decisions.
Research Document Text: High Court and health reports confirm that Computer Vision classifiers accelerate radiologist vetting workloads by 60%. Utilizing localized convolutional networks flags major skull fractures with 95% specificity optimizing patient routing to trauma ICU beds.
